sentences.en: Lestari covered a monk who teaches children in the border area.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 국경 지역에서 아이들을 가르치는 수도사를 취재했어요.

sentences.text: Fajar dan istrinya ingin hidup mandiri dan tidak tinggal bersama orang tua.
sentences.en: Fajar and his wife want to live independently and not with their parents.
sentences.ko: 파자르 부부는 부모님과 함께 살지 않고 독립해서 살고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Lestari menulis artikel tentang koperasi desa yang membuat warga lebih mandiri.
sentences.en: Lestari wrote an article about a village cooperative that made residents more self-reliant.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 주민들을 더 자립적으로 만든 마을 협동조합에 대한 기사를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Pengiring pengantin Fajar semuanya sepupu yang seumuran.
sentences.en: Fajar's groomsmen are all cousins of the same age.
sentences.ko: 파자르의 들러리는 모두 동갑내기 사촌들이에요.

sentences.text: Lestari dan rekan kerjanya seumuran, jadi mereka cepat akrab.
sentences.en: Lestari and her coworker are the same age, so they quickly became close.
sentences.ko: 레스타리와 동료는 동갑이라서 금방 친해졌어요.

sentences.text: Waktu kecil, Fajar sering disebut pemalas karena susah bangun pagi.
sentences.en: As a kid, Fajar was often called lazy because he had trouble waking up early.
sentences.ko: 어릴 때 파자르는 아침에 잘 못 일어나서 게으름뱅이라는 소리를 자주 들었어요.

sentences.text: Redaktur Lestari tidak suka pemalas yang selalu menyerahkan tulisan terlambat.
sentences.en: Lestari's editor doesn't like lazy people who always hand in their stories late.
sentences.ko: 레스타리의 편집장은 늘 기사를 늦게 내는 게으른 사람을 싫어해요.

sentences.text: Istri Fajar sangat ambisius dan berencana membuka usaha katering sendiri.
sentences.en: Fajar's wife is very ambitious and plans to open her own catering business.
sentences.ko: 파자르의 아내는 아주 야심 차서 자기 케이터링 사업을 열 계획이에요.

sentences.text: Sebagai wartawan muda yang ambisius, Lestari ingin meliput berita besar.
sentences.en: As an ambitious young reporter, Lestari wants to cover big stories.
sentences.ko: 야심 찬 젊은 기자로서 레스타리는 큰 사건을 취재하고 싶어 해요.

sentences.text: Seorang pelukis jalanan membuat lukisan wajah pengantin dalam waktu satu jam.
sentences.en: A street painter made a portrait of the bride and groom in an hour.
sentences.ko: 거리 화가 한 명이 한 시간 만에 신랑 신부 얼굴을 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Lestari mewawancarai seorang pelukis tua yang masih berkarya di usia delapan puluh.
sentences.en: Lestari interviewed an old painter who is still working at eighty.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 여든에도 여전히 작품 활동을 하는 노화가를 인터뷰했어요.

sentences.text: Pesta kecil itu terasa intim karena hanya keluarga dekat yang diundang.
sentences.en: The small party felt intimate because only close family were invited.
sentences.ko: 가까운 가족만 초대해서 그 작은 잔치는 아늑하게 느껴졌어요.

sentences.text: Lestari menolak menulis tentang kehidupan intim artis itu.
sentences.en: Lestari refused to write about that celebrity's intimate life.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 그 연예인의 사생활에 대해 쓰는 걸 거절했어요.

sentences.text: Salah satu tamu yang sembrono menumpahkan sirup ke gaun pengantin.
sentences.en: One careless guest spilled syrup on the wedding dress.
sentences.ko: 덤벙대는 손님 한 명이 웨딩드레스에 시럽을 쏟았어요.

sentences.text: Redaktur menegur Lestari karena menulis judul berita yang sembrono.
sentences.en: The editor scolded Lestari for writing a careless headline.
sentences.ko: 편집장은 기사 제목을 경솔하게 지었다고 레스타리를 꾸짖었어요.
